description: Inventory source, partition bulk evidence artifact into stable chunks, validate

steps.label: Look up source key in source_manifest to confirm expected format
Partition artifact into stable, hash-based chunks
Validate chunk IDs are stable (hash-based) and no cross-file chunks exist

notes: Chunk IDs are SHA-256 hash-based, not random — ensures stable IDs across re-runs. No cross-file chunks (each chunk belongs to exactly one source document).
